rocker_width_across.note: IMG_1493 read 1.20 in at the rear tip, +-1/16; assumed constant along the rocker

fleg_thickness_across.note: cloud inner-face depth 29-35 mm; IMG_1495 read 1.27 in

arm_thickness.note: not measurable yet; caliper A1-A3 will replace

seat_edge_thickness.note: only used without parts/seat_edge.json (or --legacy): side-edge face traced 39-45 mm at the back, thinner to the front; constant here

front_leg.profile: triangulated per line from near-frontal side photos (tools/edge_tri.py), L and R averaged; outlines +-1 mm, rear outer-face ridge is a soft line +-2 mm
front_leg.note: seat joint (v 370-470) is bridged linearly; the earlier 8-photo median trace was 13-27 mm too wide (thickness parallax)

back_leg.lower: below the seat (v 65-270): triangulated front outline and inner rear arris (tools/edge_tri.py, L+R averaged, +-1 mm); the old rear trace was +10..+11 mm off (front +0.4..+1.7); above v 270 the old trace with the correction at v 270 held; rear edge v 260-446 (seat joint, not traced) bridged by a cubic between the triangulated lines either side (fit 0.6 mm rms); it moved the rear edge there by -9..+2 mm
back_leg.upper: z 608-1028: front outline triangulated in side view from 4 cameras standing behind the leg on each side (solve residual 0.6 / 0.5 mm L / R); z 608-928: rear edge traced in side view in 2 cameras standing in front of the leg on each side, depth held on the back outer arris (residual 0.45 / 0.7 mm); L and R averaged. Above z 928 the rear follows the back-view arris, shifted to meet the side trace and ramped onto the crest's top-rear arris at the leg top (moved -2.0 mm there); z 450-608 (arm joint) is a linear ramp from the lower leg. Across-width still from the back view.

crest_pin.note: rear line pinned to the crest's top-rear arris at the leg centre (parts/crest.json); the arris slants across the leg top (about -179.0 at the inner face, -176.2 at the outer), the model's leg section does not

back_leg.across: fitted (unrolled back view, by-eye seeded edges, L+R averaged) above the seat; blended to the side plane at the rocker; rear face moved onto the triangulated back arris (was off by +5.7 mm median, 13.9 max)

seat.outline: sides y 110-400: triangulated top arris, L+R mean (+-1.5 mm); front edge: triangulated rolled edge, L+R mean (+-2 mm; parts/seat_front.json), scalloped in plan, rolled over (radius 8 assumed), top height and bottom arris triangulated (parts/seat_front_face.json); side from y 400 to the front corner: straight (hidden in the leg joint); back edge and back corners: cloud, straight in plan
seat.surface: measured inside |x| <= 251, y 64-530 (seat/surface.json: 103 tape dots on the right half, mirrored; thin-plate spline, leave-one-out 1.18 mm rms interior, 3.2 max); outside that the cloud polynomial shifted to meet it
seat.underside: plane through the two triangulated bottom arrises of the side edge (+-2.5 mm at the edge; flat across is ASSUMED, no measurement between them)

front_edge.source: parts/seat_front.json (rolled front edge traced in 8 overhead photos, tube solve, symmetric mean)
front_edge.was: straight line at y 513.6 from corner to corner (half-width 267.7)

front_face.source: parts/seat_front_face.json (top of the rolled edge: 8 overhead + 6 level/low front photos in one tube solve; bottom arris: 9 front photos; symmetric mean)

top_of_roll_moved_mm.note: measured top of the roll minus the surface the model had on that line (seat/surface.json carried to the edge)

underside_raised_at_front_mm.note: measured bottom arris minus the side-arris plane carried forward; fades out over 60 mm behind the front edge (assumed)

bottom_corner_extra_mm.note: beyond |x| 240 the bottom arris rounds up into the end of the front corner; extra rise over the line above, fades out over 25 mm behind the front edge (assumed)

front_face.face: vertical (measured lean of the bottom arris against the top outline is within +-2 mm for |x| < 240)

side_edge.source: parts/seat_edge.json (top and bottom arris of the side edge triangulated on both sides, symmetric mean)
side_edge.outline_beyond_range: cloud outline shifted by +0.0 mm (back) / +4.6 mm (front) at the end of the range, faded out over 60 mm

strip_beyond_dots_raised_mm.note: top surface outside the dotted region tilted to meet the measured top arris at the outline

arm.source: parts/arms.json design (triangulated top arrises of both arms, mirrored mean)
arm.back_extension: carried from y 68.2 back to 40.0 into the back leg (not seen)

front_leg_top.action: cut at the arm underside (it ran through the arm)

crest.source: parts/crest.json (four arrises triangulated from overhead + rear photos; design = even polynomials)

slats.edges: fitted (unrolled back view, by-eye seeded edges, L+R averaged)
slats.surface: back face located by photo consistency in 7 height bands, separately for centre and outer slats
slats.thickness_provenance: front-face cloud layer vs photo-consistent back face (about 10 mm)
